flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findNoticesForMhaNricUpload, findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/{helpers/MhaNricDataHelper, jobs/MhaNricUploadJob}, download/{jobs/MhaNricDownloadJob, helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper}}, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (resetLetterAddressAfterToppan), resources cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no driver particulars check code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info for ANS; Vault connection permission is granted to the App Service) - cannot verify from repo. There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The particulars check and update (Epic OCMS8) lives in the MHA upload/download jobs (NRIC, id_type N) and the DataHive UEN/FIN job (id_type F and B), the same path as owner/hirer in OCMS12.6; the selection queries include stages DN1 and DN2 and do not distinguish owner/hirer/driver, so a driver notice about to climb to the 2nd letter is checked too. Updates only touch the current offender row (OCMS-DF-2026-177, Closed, Prod deployment), which matters for a driver furnished after the enquiry file was sent. Gaps: (1) the DataHive UEN/FIN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false); a driver with ID type P (passport) is in neither the MHA nor the DataHive query; (2) no code gates the 2nd letter on the MHA result, the order comes only from the cron schedule (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15); (3) the story condition that the electronic reminder was sent or the driver opted out is not a condition in the MHA/Toppan queries; (4) a driver who only has a furnished_mail address loses letter_address after DN1 (the reset uses mha_reg -> lta_reg -> lta_mail), so is filtered out at DN2 if MHA does not fill an address; (5) the file exchange with MHA, the result file content, Vault and SFTP permission cannot be verified from the repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-177 (Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-133 (remark: the MHA cron was not yet turned on in PRD in June 2026; OCMS-DF-2026-177 observed MHA results in PRD on 25 Aug 2026; current value cannot be verified), OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamp, Ready to UAT).
recommendation: Claim partially. The MHA (NRIC) check and particulars update exist and cover driver notices at DN1/DN2; DataHive for FIN/UEN is off in PROD, passports are not checked, and nothing makes the 2nd letter wait for the check result or the e-reminder status. Confirm with URA the PROD status of the MHA and DataHive UEN/FIN crons and whether a gate before DN2 is needed.

steps.step: OCMS selects the driver notices about to climb to the 2nd letter (stage DN2) to check their particulars with MHA (NRIC holders)
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type = 'N', offender_indicator = 'Y', not yet in ocms_nro_temp and the ID not in ocms_hst (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:563-581). The helper calls this query (MhaNricDataHelper.java:77-81) and MhaNricUploadJob builds the enquiry file from the result (MhaNricUploadJob.java:156). The query does not distinguish owner/hirer/driver, so an NRIC driver who is at DN1 and will go to DN2 is sent to MHA too. The story condition that the electronic reminder was sent or the driver opted out is not checked in this query. Schedule: cron.mhaupload.schedule=0 0 9,14,21 ? * MON-SAT, enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106); the value on the PROD server cannot be verified from the repo (the OCMS-DF-2026-133 remark says the MHA cron was not yet turned on in PRD in June 2026).

steps.step: The driver's latest particulars from MHA (NRIC holder) are received and updated (name, date of birth/death, life status, address) on the current offender record
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadJob reads the result file (processResponseFile, MhaNricDownloadJob.java:556) then applyStatusUpdates (MhaNricDownloadJob.java:633; MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:484-486). It updates name, lifeStatus, dateOfBirth, dateOfDeath and the mha_reg address only for the row where offender_indicator = 'Y' (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:777-779 and 834-860); when the ID is no longer the offender, the record is skipped and goes to the error rows of the report. That matters for a driver furnished after the enquiry file was sent (OCMS-DF-2026-177, Closed, Prod deployment). The download job is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Sebagian because the NRO file exchange with MHA over SFTP and the result file content cannot be verified from the repo; OCMS-DF-2026-133 says the MHA cron was not yet turned on in PRD in June 2026 while OCMS-DF-2026-177 observed MHA results in PRD on 25 Aug 2026, the current value cannot be verified; OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamp not updated) is still Ready to UAT.

steps.step: The particulars of FIN-holder and company (UEN) drivers are checked and updated through DataHive
steps.detail: DataHiveUenFinService selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type IN ('F','B'), offender_indicator = 'Y' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:225-250), so FIN/UEN drivers at DN1/DN2 are included. But MhaDownloadJobsScheduler skips the second job when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:43 and 104-107) and the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, comment: wait for the DataHive view name to be verified). So in the prod configuration FIN/UEN drivers are not checked. A driver with ID type P (passport) is in neither the MHA query (id_type N) nor the DataHive query (F, B), so is never checked on this path. The content of the DataHive view (DOS) cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: After the check and update, the driver notice can get the 2nd letter (DN2), and a notice suspended by the check result is not processed
steps.detail: The Toppan query for stage DN2 only takes notices with suspension_type IS NULL (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614), so a notice given TS-NRO or PS by the MHA result (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:872-880, 1118-1130) is not printed. But no code gates the 2nd letter on the MHA result: the Toppan query does not look at ocms_nro_temp and the order only comes from the cron schedule (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15; cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62, 105, 119). If the MHA result file is a day late, the DN2 notice is still processed by Toppan with the old address. The DN2 letter address comes from the letter_address reset after DN1 using the order mha_reg -> lta_reg -> lta_mail without furnished_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:494-517), so a driver who only has a furnished_mail address and gets no MHA address is filtered out of DN2 (ToppanUploadJob.java:266); from reading the code, not tested. The DN2 letter itself (file creation and delivery) is covered by OCMS12.41. Sebagian.
